notes.title: Orderly Havoc 1.0.3 Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]ORDERLY HAVOC 1.0.3[/h1]

This is another small patch which contains some more bug fixes, Quality of Life, and a small change made to the key item.

[h2]Keys[/h2]
Some players found it frustrating that key items could not be held while carrying another item. We’ve made two changes that will help alleviate this issue.
- Keys can now be held by players independently of other items.
- Multiple keys can now be held at the same time.

This should help keys feel less restrictive and easier to manage while doing other tasks.

[h2]QoL/Polish[/h2]
- Added silver crown icon to indicate whether a level has been completed or not.
- Added gold crown icon to indicate whether a level has been completed on the highest difficulty or not. 
- Added pulse animation for the nodes in the restore electricity minigame for visual feedback purposes.
- Updated Do taxes icon in the chore list.
- Added dial hand to thermostat minigame.
- Slightly repositioned desk in meat room.
- Made grass collision larger for interaction with Mow lawn objective.
- Fixed an issue causing some offsets when plugging in wires in the Organize wires minigame. Wire outputs now snap to sockets.
- Added tutorial text to restart nuclear generator minigame.
- Gauge in the Nuclear generator minigame now turns green when close to the sweet spot instead of red.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
- Fixed an issue causing minigame clock to stay on screen when the player interacted with an objective while taking pills.
- Fixed an issue causing some parts of the pistol mesh to be displaced when the player is caffeinated.
- Fixed an issue causing the thermostat button to be improperly transparent.
- Fixed an issue causing improper depth layering on laundry basket held item.
- Fixed an issue preventing footsteps from being played when the player disables camera shake.
- Fixed an issue preventing some gameplay options from not updating properly while in the middle of a level.
- Fixed an issue preventing broom from being properly highlighted when the Clean floor objective was active.
- Fixed an issue causing texture stretching in Lock gates minigame when on certain resolutions.
- Fixed Korean localization issue in Do taxes minigame.
- Fixed an issue causing the “Fill dog bowl with dog food” text in chore list to fall back to English in other languages.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
- Increased progress granted in grind meat minigame. (5% per meat hit > 10% per meat hit)
- Increased dog kibble acceptance window. (20 filled tolerance > 50-95 filled tolerance)
- Made droplet rate in water the plant minigame more consistent. (0.8-3.0s > 1.2s)
- Slightly increased Clean furniture minigame progress granted. (0.4% per dust > 0.8% per dust)
- Decreased delay between equations in Do taxes minigame. (1.2s > 0.5-0.75s)
- Decreased delay between clothing spawning when mismatching items. (3s > 1s)
- Decreased amount of meat slots that spawn in Fill fridge with meat minigame. (4-6 > 3-5)
- Adjusted delay between missed grass cuts in Mow lawn minigame. (1-3s > 1s)
- Adjusted delay between misaligned screw spawning. (1.25-2.0s > 0.5-0.75s)
- Increased degree tolerance for repair window minigame. (35 degrees > 45 degrees)

[h2]Colour blind Assist[/h2]
We’ve added some options that should help players who are colour blind with minigames. While there currently are only a few features, we are open to adding more in the future based on any feedback to do so.

- Added colour blind assistance option in the gameplay settings menu.
- Added symbols to files in Organize files minigame.
- Added symbols to power nodes in Restore electricity minigame
- Added particle effects to soapy droplets in Do the dishes minigame.

Note: While localization has been added for these options for French, Spanish, and Korean the localization has not been updated for Simplified Chinese yet so a follow up patch should be expected with these changes coming.

[h2]Misc.[/h2]
- Updated menu credits.
- Generic computer.

That’s all for this patch. Keep an eye out for future updates to the game which will include new content. Once again thank you all for playing Orderly Havoc, we hope you have enjoyed what the game has to offer so far.

-Angad

notes.title: Orderly Havoc 1.0.2 - Small follow up patch
notes.notes:
Some issues were noted to still exist after the 1.0.1 patch so we've pushed another small patch to fix up some more bugs.

- Reworked save data logic for Industrial Titan achievement.
- Fixed an issue causing player to have to press twice to open the pistol door on industry 3 and 4.
- Fixed an issue causing note highlight to stay active even after notes are put back down.
- Fixed an issue preventing all pistol components from being properly highlighted.
- Fixed an issue preventing crosshair from properly opening when player was aiming at the Scrap Figure with loaded pistol.

notes.title: Orderly Havoc 1.0.1 - Bug Patch
notes.notes:
This patch contains various bug fixes, optimizations, and visual updates for Orderly Havoc.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[h1]UI[/h1]
- Fixed an issue preventing UI crosshair from being properly overlapped when playing a minigame.
- Fixed an issue causing displacement when detecting collision in grind meat minigame on non 16:9 resolutions.
- Fixed an issue causing minigames to spawn two arms, with one of them being offset.
- Fixed an issue causing Crouch tooltip to not display proper key for crouching.
- Fixed an issue causing some text in chore lists to briefly display font syntax when printing phrases.
- Fixed an issue causing note widget to appear under displayed dialogue.
- Added a failsafe for Collect the trash and Clean the floor minigames when physics scraps glitch outside bounds.
- Added delay between when playing could press Thermostat button to prevent confusion when playing minigame for the first time.
- Made it slightly visually and physically easier to complete Collect the trash minigame.

[b]NEW[/b]

- Added new crosshair visual for minigames to help players understand where cursor hitpoint is.
- Added larger trash bag at bottom of Collect the trash.
- Added a use tooltip for Notes.
[h1]Optimization[/h1]
- Fixed an issue causing several tooltip widgets to be created at once causing severe hitching for some users.
- Fixed an issue causing multiple writes to save game data to be called at once causing severe hitching for some users.
- Removed empty material functions causing slight hitching when loading specific material.
- Removed tick events from all interactable, item, and item spawn classes.
- Clamped 3D resolution scale (1-100) preventing users from setting the value to 0 which would completely reset 3D resolution.
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
- Fixed an issue causing a soft lock to occur while completing tasks that have multiple interactables after objectives have been turned meaty (Collect trash around the house, Clean the windows, Clean the furniture)
- Fixed an issue causing a softlock when completing some minigames while game over screen was appearing.
- Fixed an issue causing meat spawned in world for "Collect the meat" chore from not highlighting properly when activated.
- Fixed an issue causing some item names to stay highlighted when a minigame was completed with highlight items active.
- Fixed an issue causing the Lawn Mower to not trigger a highlight on the Grass when objective was active.
- Fixed an issue causing snowy landscape to be invisible when snowy weather was activated.
- Fixed an issue causing some debugs to be visible in the Toilet minigame.
- Fixed an issue causing Mail paper to spawn after minigame has been completed on controller.
- Added a slight delay to generic interaction for the Computer.
- Removed debug "Text" from being displayed inside the microwave.

[b]NEW[/b]

- At the end of House 4, players are now forced to toss pills into the shower drain.
[h1]Achievements[/h1]
- Fixed an issue preventing save game from properly storing House and Industry levels completed, preventing the unlock for House Champion and Industry Titan.
[h1]Audio[/h1]
- Fixed an issue causing footsteps to sound snowy when snowy weather was not present.
- Fixed an issue causing some music to stop instantly.
- Fixed an issue preventing music track in House 3 from starting if playing level for the first time.
- Fixed an issue causing scrap figure's radio static to continue playing in background after player reaches game over screen.

[b]Known problems:[/b]

All these issues are still being looked into.

- Some users may have experienced cursor displacement when playing some minigames. This issue is still being looked into, however playing in Windowed or Borderless Windowed seems to fix this issue.
- There is a rare softlock that can occur after players start making coffee in House 1.
- There is a rare softlock that can occur after players clean the last bit of floor in Industry 2.

Thank you to everyone who has played Orderly Havoc. We will keep an eye out for any more issues that need to be looked at, we hope you enjoy the game.

- Angad (Game Designer/Programmer)
